You see a hellfire fighter.

    Notes

    Rage sometimes becomes an urge too strong to be controlled. Which is true for creatures like humans, is even more evident in the demon kind. In some of the demons the fire of hatred grows so strong that they are consumed by this inner, hellish fire. Some of them are powerful enough to fight back that urge for a while. They are equipped with hellish armors to contain the destructive energy that burns through them. They save their lives for the price of an existence in consuming and eternal pain, hatred and rage. Driven to the edge of madness and sometimes beyond, those demons love to release some of their anger and inner fire upon others. Exhaustive fight is their only way to find relief. The so-called Hellfire Fighters fight and destroy with everything that is left of their minds and consciousness in the ocean of rage and pain that had become their lives. Never expect a Hellfire Fighter to give in or to retreat. They will always fight to the bitter end.

    —Tibia Library

    Location

    Pits of Inferno, Demon Forge, Fury Dungeon.

    Behaviour

    This monster will spam fire spells. Not too dangerous if you avoid the beam.

    A hellfire fighter attacks in melee range. A hellfire fighter never retreats.

    History

    • Its experience was decreased from 3900 to 1365 with the first batch of changes of Update 12.31. It was later increased to 3120 with the second batch.
    • As announced on March 12, 2024, the patch reduced the probability of its Fire Bomb and the affected tiles, as well as raised its experience from 3,120 to 3,400 as part of the 2024 Balancing Project.
    • As announced on April 9, 2024, the patch reduced the probability of its Fire Bomb even further and increased its experience from 3,400 to 3,800 as part of the 2024 Balancing Project.
